svg.aria-label: Recorded repository lineage and selected ancestry
svg.title: Recorded repository lineage and selected ancestry
svg.desc: Branches connect parent and child repositories. The blue path traces the selected repository's ancestry. Filled nodes have recorded validation scores; outlined nodes do not.
